step1:dimcustomer.text: {"task_id": "dimcustomer", "step": "recipe", "grain": "One row per customer (customerid).", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM CustomerXML AS c INNER JOIN ActionXML AS a ON c.ActionSeq = a.ActionSeq LEFT JOIN NameXML AS n ON c.CustomerSeq = n.CustomerSeq LEFT JOIN AddressXML AS addr ON c.CustomerSeq = addr.CustomerSeq LEFT JOIN ContactInfoXML AS ci ON c.CustomerSeq = ci.CustomerSeq LEFT JOIN C_PHONE_1_XML AS p1 ON ci.ContactSeq = p1.ContactSeq LEFT JOIN C_PHONE_2_XML AS p2 ON ci.ContactSeq = p2.ContactSeq LEFT JOIN C_PHONE_3_XML AS p3 ON ci.ContactSeq = p3.ContactSeq LEFT JOIN TaxInfoXML AS ti ON c.CustomerSeq = ti.CustomerSeq LEFT JOIN TaxRate AS tr_nat ON ti.C_NAT_TX_ID = tr_nat.TX_ID LEFT JOIN TaxRate AS tr_loc ON ti.C_LCL_TX_ID = tr_loc.TX_ID LEFT JOIN Prospect AS pr ON upper(n.C_L_NAME) = upper(pr.LastName) AND upper(n.C_F_NAME) = upper(pr.FirstName) AND upper(addr.C_ADLINE1) = upper(pr.AddressLine1) AND upper(addr.C_ADLINE2) = upper(pr.AddressLine2) AND upper(addr.C_ZIPCODE) = upper(pr.PostalCode)"}], "combine": "none", "group_by": null, "decisions": {"joins": ["INNER JOIN ActionXML to get ActionType and ActionTS for each customer event", "LEFT JOIN NameXML, AddressXML, ContactInfoXML, phone XMLs, TaxInfoXML, TaxRate (national and local), and Prospect to attach customer attributes"], "stacked": false, "deduplicated": false, "aggregated": false}, "assumptions": []}

step2:dimcustomer.gender.text: {"task_id": "dimcustomer.gender", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(CASE WHEN c.C_GNDR IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN upper(c.C_GNDR) IN ('M','F') THEN upper(c.C_GNDR) ELSE 'U' END AS CHAR(1))"}], "uses": ["c.C_GNDR"], "class": "conditional", "assumptions": []}
